packageRules.description: Everything that automerges goes into ONE weekly PR: one build of each image per week instead of one per dependency, and no rebase-and-rebuild cascade when one of many PRs merges

Every action is pinned to a commit for an exact version tag, so a digest update of one means that tag was moved to a different commit, which is what a hijacked action looks like (tj-actions/changed-files, 2025). Never automerged, never mixed into the weekly PR (one non-automerge update would hold the whole group), opened at once

Automerged updates wait 3 days after their release, so a broken or pulled release is usually gone before it is merged. Only for datasources that report release times: without one Renovate would hold the update forever

Claude Code (flatpak/build.sh, Containerfile) follows Anthropic's stable channel, the npm dist-tag 'stable': a release about a week old, skipping those with major regressions, instead of every daily one
Majors (and replacements) are never automerged: their own PR, CI runs on it, and it waits for the owner (assigned and asked for review) to merge it

The Fedora toolbox base image is not managed as a docker tag: the registry carries the next release (branched) and rawhide as plain numbers long before they are released, so a docker lookup would propose rawhide. The fedora custom manager below follows released Fedora versions instead
The move to the next Fedora release: every pin in one PR, opened as soon as endoflife.date lists the release (i.e. once it is out, not on the weekend after), never automerged

customManagers.description: Fedora release the dev container is built on: the fedora-toolbox tag in the Containerfile, and the scanner container in scan.sh
Versions in workflow files under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment (cosign-release, tool versions)

The development tools and VS Code extensions in tools.txt and extensions.txt: the line under each '# renovate:' comment is 'name version asset checksum members license [source]'. A checksum of sha256:<hex> (releases that publish none) is the digest the github-release-attachments datasource bumps with the version; the #sha256:<hex> of a license URL is not matched and stays as it is
Versions under a renovate comment in the Containerfile (ARG lines) and in flatpak/build.sh (VAR=value lines)
